changelog:
Initial release of bsv-cx-verify — a free, trustless Bitcoin SV (BSV) Merkle proof verifier.

- Verifies Merkle proofs (TSC, BEEF, BUMP) of BSV transactions against independently synced block headers
- Requires no account or trust in bsv.cx; proofs validated against node-synced headers, not explorer APIs
- Provides endpoints to fetch BEEF or BUMP proofs for any txid
- Clear success/failure ('confirmed', 'rejected', 'inconclusive') responses for proof verification
- Self-documenting API endpoint at /spv; full usage examples and safety notes included
summary: Verify any Bitcoin (BSV) Merkle proof — free, no account, trusting no one including bsv.cx — against a block-headers node bsv.cx syncs itself over the BSV P2P network. Send a raw TSC proof, a BEEF envelope, or a BUMP; get confirmed / rejected / inconclusive. Also fetch BEEF/BUMP for a txid.
